address: 45 The Hayes, Saint Davids Centre, Cardiff,CF10 1GA
bio: The Ivy Asia Cardiff features interiors that have a luxurious and theatrical Asian inspired design, from the dazzling green stone floor to the stunning antique décor on display.  The Afternoon Tea menu has an Asian twist, with savouries including spicy avocado maki rolls and a selection of sweet treats such as vanilla & sesame creme brulee and raspberry macaroons. For an extra-special occasion, make it a day to remember by adding a glass of Champagne.  The Ivy Asia Cardiff is located in St David's Shopping Centre, just a short walk from the city’s historic castle and Cardiff Market.  Afternoon Tea is served every day from 3pm to 4.45pm and costs £29.95 per person, or £39.95 with a glass of Champagne. Minimum booking 2 people.
